definitions.explanation: A warm golden-brown color resembling ripe wheat. Most commonly used to describe skin that has been tanned by the sun. Composed of 小麦 (wheat) + 色 (color).

examples.japanese: {小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{健康的|けんこうてき}だ。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧。
examples.english: I got a golden tan over the summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧{小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けした→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children with suntanned skin from swimming in the sea are playing energetically.

notes:
USAGE:
{小麦色|こむぎいろ} is most commonly used to describe sun-tanned skin, carrying a positive connotation of health and vitality. It can also describe the color of bread, baked goods, or other golden-brown objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (golden-brown skin)
- {小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (to get tanned golden-brown)
- {小麦色|こむぎいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けする→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧ (to get a wheat-colored tan)
